description: Return the caller's OWN metered usage rollup (metric `captured_entries` = count of captured entries per device per period; from stripe_usage_events, owner-scoped to the caller's OAuth sub) aggregated by period over a window. `since_days` (default 30, max 365), `metric` (default captured_entries). A billing:view operator may pass `all_users:true` for the fleet. Returns { metric, since, count, total_quantity, usage:[{period_start, device_uuid, quantity, reported_at}] }.

all_users.description: billing:view/admin only — return EVERY account's usage.

since_days.description: Look back this many days (1–365, default 30).

user_id.description: billing:view/admin only — a specific target user.

name: get_usage
title: Get Usage
